novelty: All are previously untested fields at previously used entries, not new entries or third-party blind queries. Inputs reuse frozen six-case repository/Orders or eight-case travel structures.
selection: All remaining candidates; no replacements after planning.
order: Freeze truth and driver; commit protocol; plan all queries; native capture by entry then full and selective per accepted query. Refused TF queries remain in inventory and native evaluation.

runtime.TF: 32/256 MiB heap, GC threads1, compiler threads2
runtime.MirrorTaint: 32/512 MiB heap (historical qualified preset), GC threads1, compiler threads2

independent_truth.repository: Literal original repository return/list order and declared physical field/element coordinates; route filter selected source index determined from original predicate and actual documents. UUID serialization projection is checked separately from identity.
independent_truth.basic_percent: Original default0 or literal setPercent(1), no declared input-field data source; selection evidence excluded.
independent_truth.basic_train: Actual Train RPC response.data physical field, original JsonUtils default conversion.
independent_truth.ticketinfo: Actual incoming Basic RPC response leaf at identical relative JSON path, including explicit null.
independent_truth.orders_nested: Original Customer/Address/Card references, actual raw HTTP decode facts, field identity/version, ignored id yields default null. Empty associations produce no elements.
independent_truth.orders_customerId: Original Future customer Resource.getId().getHref() then parseId. Require actual self-link and decoded physical Link.href coordinate; absent coordinate is oracle unavailable.
independent_truth.orders_id: Mongo-generated ID lacks independently audited generator/field source coordinate in this protocol: oracle unavailable, never presumed empty.

failure_policy: First outcomes immutable. Core changes forbidden; experiment/evaluation defects retain initial records and separate corrected evaluation. Missing targets N/A, literal null is a target; unknown, analysis_limited, invalid, known_unchecked distinct.
baseline_packaging: Native author JAR and fixed v09 adapter unchanged; relocate only exporter private Jackson. Read-only witness installed first to record original business mapper definitions. Historical368 mask is not silently replaced by this new configuration.
